def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]
    # The source multicolor object is the non-background, non-marker component

    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,8)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # pivot at the center of its bounding box
    pr=(r0+r1)//2; pc=(c0+c1)//2
    pattern=[(r-pr,c-pc,grid[r][c]) for r,c in pts]

            rr,cc=tr+dr,tc+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,8)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    # Source object's anchor is the interior 0 at local (2,2) in this task;
    # identify the source cluster's zero nearest its bounding-box center.
    r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    center=((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2)
    zeros=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==0]
